literal: "we are destitute" saying, coveting they will not do, senses conquered, baseness without vision they.
translation: Those of flawless vision who have conquered their senses will not covet others' wealth, thinking "we are destitute."
modern: ஐம்புலன்களையும் வென்ற குற்றமற்ற அறிவினை உடையவர்கள், தமக்கு வறுமை வந்துவிட்டது என்று நினைத்து பிறர் பொருளை விரும்ப மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet describes the steadfastness of those who have mastered their five senses and possess a clear, flawless understanding. Even when faced with severe poverty, they will not use their destitution as an excuse to covet what belongs to others. The word 'புலம்' refers to the senses, whose conquest ensures that material desires do not cloud their 'காட்சி' (vision or understanding). Thus, true wisdom prevents the base act of coveting, regardless of one's circumstances.
